data.one_liner: Render TeX to PNG using KaTeX in a native WebView
data.what_it_does: This plugin renders TeX markup to a PNG image via a lightweight native WebView and displays it as an image widget. It uses KaTeX for rendering and supports Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to display mathematical expressions in a Flutter app
You want a lightweight solution without pulling in the full webview_flutter dependency
You prefer PNG output for consistent sizing
avoid_when: You need support for iOS 9 or 10
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.47
You require dynamic HTML/CSS rendering instead of PNG
strengths: Lightweight – only a single native WebView is used
weaknesses: No support for older Flutter versions
